description: This is the main application startup file for an ASP.NET Core web application, responsible for configuring services (such as database context, Swagger, localization, CORS, JWT authentication) and middleware pipeline, as well as initializing the database.

classes.name: WebApplication
classes.description: The main application object used to configure and run the ASP.NET Core web app.

methods.name: AddDbContext
methods.description: Registers the database context with dependency injection, configuring SQLite or SQL Server based on configuration.

methods.name: UseSqlite
methods.description: Configures the database context to use SQLite.

methods.name: UseSqlServer
methods.description: Configures the database context to use SQL Server.

methods.name: AddLocalization
methods.description: Configures localization services with resources located in 'Resources' folder.

methods.name: AddSwaggerGen
methods.description: Configures Swagger/OpenAPI generation with security and documentation settings.

methods.name: AddCors
methods.description: Enables CORS with permissive settings allowing any origin, header, and method.

methods.name: AddMvc
methods.description: Adds MVC services with custom conventions, filters, and JSON options.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT authentication services (likely a custom extension method).

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds the application pipeline based on the configured builder.

methods.name: UseMiddleware
methods.description: Adds custom middleware for error handling.

methods.name: UseMvc
methods.description: Adds MVC middleware for request routing.

methods.name: UseSwagger
methods.description: Serves the generated Swagger JSON document.

methods.name: UseSwaggerUI
methods.description: Serves the Swagger UI for API exploration.

methods.name: CreateScope
methods.description: Creates a scope for dependency injection to initialize the database.

methods.name: GetRequiredService
methods.description: Retrieves a required service from the dependency injection container.

methods.name: EnsureCreated
methods.description: Ensures the database is created; if it does not exist, it will be created.
